title: precheck — the issue precheck's verdict (more-local-inference 07)
description: A local model's check of one queued issue before the factory spends hosted credits on it. `gate` checks the Input receipt and applies two rules of its own: a verdict other than ready with no evidence counts as ready, and a blocked verdict whose blocker is not an open issue in the same repository counts as ready. `post` publishes the result as the issue's precheck marker comment. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

verdict.description: ready: nothing found against running it. already_done: the checkout already does what every acceptance criterion asks. blocked: it needs another open issue in this repository first. contradiction: an acceptance criterion needs something a non-goal of the same issue excludes. unclear: no acceptance criterion can be checked.

summary.description: One to three sentences a human can act on. Published verbatim.

evidence.description: What the verdict rests on, one entry each. Must name where: a file and line for already_done, the blocking issue for blocked, the criterion and the non-goal for contradiction. May be empty only for ready.

where.description: path:line in the checkout, #N for an issue, or `issue body` for a quote from this issue.

says.description: What is there, quoted or in one sentence.

blocker.description: Only for blocked: the open issue in this repository that must be done first.
